phase: GND2 shared server world replay and renderer
scope: server-shared-ground-v2, explicit owner-local opt-in, no production enablement
journal: Migration0010 adds independent shared state/source/batch tables. Once explicitly started, SQLite world-update trigger atomically appends every accepted raw world revision with engine wall timestamp. Sources are immutable; no reset, deletion or backfill of historical positions. Existing GND1 sessions/receipts remain unchanged.
clock: Genesis uses existing world simtime. Thereafter canonical ground simtime integrates accepted pause/scale at journal capture boundaries, in fixed100ms real ticks subdivided to <=100ms simulation steps. It does not rewind/rebase actor positions or trust caller time. Ground clock is separately reported; existing reward/world clock is unchanged.
physics: Persist and restore WalkDirector, TagDirector, PetWalkDirector and TrafficDirector state; all core/NPC<=243 humans plus3animals and12cars participate independently of camera/visible budget. Shared footprints, peer sweeps, bicycles/pets/tag and conservative continuous car/pedestrian checks; unsafe traffic step is held/recomputed, never teleported.
lifecycle: Process every journal revision in order at its acceptance boundary. Record source/plan/roster replacement/removal and clock transitions; retain source raw snapshot. New actors are explicit simulation spawns, not observed history. Lifecycle/poses do not imply completed activity, witnessed knowledge or P2P.
persistence: Whole shared state, source cursor, server frame window and operation receipt commit with exact world/source/state CAS and SQL postassert. All explicit advances, including zero-step, have durable idempotent operation receipts. Abort/ignore/race/corruption fail closed, no partial cursor/frames. Default status is read-only.
renderer: Opt-in ?ground=shared reads owner-local server snapshot and samples its retained frame window using server-aligned wall time minus fixed playback delay. No local WalkDirector/TrafficDirector, position extrapolation or per-viewer spawn in shared mode. Hold when frames unavailable; do not silently fall back to local physics. Camera selection only changes rendering subset.
pulse: Reuse existing local owner pulse; base learning/narrative admission remains unchanged. An active shared world may advance once per wall second with CAS/coalescing; no new cron, model call or automation. Shared-mode page uses existing pulse/poll loop at1s; default page cadence unchanged.
verification: Deterministic capture-boundary replay/resume, all-actor occupancy, fixed-step speed/collision, source lifecycle and pause/scale, atomic native/D1 rollback/ignore/CAS/idempotency, two late-opened browser viewers with same server frame and camera-independent poses; fresh local screenshots. No live DB/GPU/SLA claim.
